description: This file defines React components that encapsulate and extend the '@radix-ui/react-hover-card' primitives to provide a custom hover card UI component set, including root, trigger, and content components with styling and behavior.

methods.name: HoverCard
methods.description: Main component wrapping the Radix HoverCard Root with additional props and slot data.

methods.name: HoverCardTrigger
methods.description: Component wrapping the Trigger primitive, providing a data slot identifier.

methods.name: HoverCardContent
methods.description: Component rendering the Content primitive inside a Portal, with styling, alignment, and offset options.
